body: U+0023 2026-10-02: prototype changes specced with interphase and dispatched with mitosisU+000AU+000AU+0023# Spec (interphase prototype pathway)U+000AU+002D Request: bring the updated Claude Design prototype in docs/prototype (Field Notes, Onboarding and Meadow Scene .dc.html, CLAUDE.md design rules) into live Field Notes on phone and macOS, using the Claude Design summary as a guide; the owner later added /Users/satanshumishra/Downloads/field-notes-icon-rose.svg as the app icon.U+000AU+002D Live baseline: origin/main e36ea842 (PRs 249 and 250 from the parallel session); the local main checkout is behind at 8aa7fd08 and holds the owner's uncommitted prototype files plus a modified tool/probe/macos/drive.sh. Live code was read from a scratch export of origin/main.U+000AU+002D The design session ran 13:23 to 16:37 MDT in Claude Design project eafe8d73-b380-44be-9b2e-6431c0f35f26; its first archive copies (Field Notes v1, Onboarding v1, Meadow Scene) are the pre-session state, and the v1-to-current diffs were read in full. The chat export stops at 256 KiB, so this session's chat was not readable.U+000AU+002D Sweeps found changes the summary omitted: the macOS Meadow redesign and focus mode, the collapsible macOS sidebar, a macOS onboarding glass Back button, the toggle moving out of the macOS title bar, glass toasts on both platforms, and a time-of-day picker where the summary said Play the day.U+000AU+002D Live gaps found: the voice card had no playback colouring, playhead or seek; every phone dialog was centred; phone onboarding had no Back button or swipe; petals were cut from bloom paths.U+000AU+002D Spec files (git-ignored): docs/specs/prototype-phone-macos-changes.md, .decisions.md, .record.json, .items.json, .icon.svg. 31 Steps, 63 criteria (5 unproven, needing the owner's devices), 12 assumptions, 0 open questions.U+000AU+002D Independent spec review found 20 issues, all fixed before approval: hit areas versus visual sizes, the app-wide toast lift, extracting the private mood-change flow, Today's top inset under the header, the streak_card export, meadow_ribbon and garden_header files, the Meadow accessibility sweep, onboarding tests that tap the phone Next, phone-only Other ways methods, StreakPill replica options, waveform semantics, accessibility fixes tests, device rendering marked unproven, and the macOS toggle gap between units.U+000AU+002D The owner approved the read-back and the written spec on 2026-10-02.U+000AU+000AU+0023# IncidentsU+000AU+002D Playwright MCP wrote .playwright-mcp/ into the repo root during prototype rendering; it was moved to the session scratchpad and the in-app browser used instead. The tree guard verified clean at hand-off.U+000AU+002D The first wave 1 launch failed in seconds: every headless Worker printed "You've hit your weekly limit" because the CLI was signed into the wrong account. The owner switched accounts; Opus and Sonnet then answered, and wave 1 was resumed with run.zsh 1 --resume (the refused log is wave1-refused.log). The monitor saw two Workers alive after 60 s.U+000AU+000AU+0023# Dispatch state at thread creationU+000AU+002D Run kit: ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/ (CHARTER.md, worker-rules.txt, dispatch.zsh, accept.zsh with TZ=America/Edmonton for garden goldens, run.zsh 1|2, pr_adapter.py for the five units, wave1/wave2 items).U+000AU+002D Branches: mitosis/prototype-phone-macos-base at e36ea842; mitosis/proto-phone-shell and mitosis/proto-app-icon created by mitosis at the base.U+000AU+002D Wave 2 has not started; its base is the wave 1 shell branch.U+000AU+002D Receipts doctor was run at session start: the config is stale (see out-of-scope).
